titre: Kill Fee - Solo dev - Hotline Miami meets a cyberpunk Rainbow Six
chapo: Hi r/Games , I'm Charlie, a solo developer. I've just announced my game, Kill Fee . Trailer here. The inspiration is Hotline Miami's pace , the tactics of the early Rainbow Six games, and the way old games like Duke Nukem 3D let you mess with things you wouldn't expect. It's a frenetic top-down shooter. You're a licensed contractor taking jobs from insurers, property groups, port security and…
